About Me

I am currently pursuing a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) at Anjalai Ammal Mahalingam Engineering College, with a CGPA of 8.4. I completed my B.Sc. in Information Technology at Bon Secours College for Women with an A+ grade.

I have a foundational understanding of Java and Python, along with basic experience in Power BI, Tableau, and Figma. I have developed academic projects including a photo-sharing and messaging web application, a campus management application, an AI-powered career guidance chatbot, and a 360-degree virtual museum.

My research interests include beacon technology and quantum-enhanced emotion recognition, with one research paper published in the JAAFR International Research Journal and another presented at a conference.

I am passionate about emerging technologies, Artificial Intelligence, UI/UX design, and mobile application development. I am seeking an entry-level opportunity where I can apply my knowledge, enhance my technical skills, and contribute to meaningful software development projects.
